notes: The 36-tile ring, five landmark positions, central anchor and portrait framing agree with the target topology.
All five roles are distinguishable, but Archive and Sanctuary remain simplified and Palace tiering lacks the target's shell-rich silhouette.
Large smooth cylinders and cones replace the target's layered arches, balconies, ribs, recesses and inhabited facade rhythm.
Coral and root systems exist around 360 degrees, but appear as sparse perimeter props instead of terraces grown into the architecture.
Fish, manta, whale, jellyfish, bubbles, submarine, motes, surface and rays establish an active underwater volume.
Turquoise, pearl, gold and amber are present, but fog and batching still flatten material response compared with the luminous target.
